name: Merge Two Sorted Linked Lists
description: Merges two sorted linked lists into a single sorted list by comparing heads and linking the smaller one.
aim: Produce a single sorted linked list from two sorted lists without extra allocation by re-linking existing nodes.
howItWorks: Link the smaller head to result
Advance the pointer of the smaller list
Repeat until one list is exhausted

complexity.spaceDescription: In-place pointer manipulation — no new nodes

whenToUse: Merge sort implementation on linked lists
alternatives: Convert to arrays, merge, convert back — O(n+m) time and space
Recursive merge — elegant but O(n+m) stack space
